preconditions.description: The number of parcels n must be between 1 and 500.
The strength of the platform S must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ini < outi < 2 * n for ini, outi, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: For each parcel, the arrival time ini must be less than the delivery time outi, and both must be within the range of 0 to 2n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi <= 1000 and 0 <= si <= 1000 and 1 <= vi <= 10**6 for ini, outi, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: Each parcel's weight wi, strength si, and value vi must be within their specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum sum of bourles that Jaroslav can get.
